# Data

Large data files are not stored in this repository due to size constraints.

## Download Instructions

- **MovieLens 32M**: https://grouplens.org/datasets/movielens/
- **TMDb metadata**: fetched via TMDb API (see `04_external_features/01_tmdb_api.py`)

## Files generated by this project

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| tmdb_meta_full.csv | TMDb metadata for all MovieLens movies |
| tmdb_meta_sample.csv | TMDb metadata sample (100 movies) |
